name: APLD AI HPC Infrastructure Valuation — 75MW RFS Milestone
rationale: Applied Digital (APLD) achieved Ready for Service (RFS) for 75 MW at Polaris Forge 1 Building 2 Phase 2, bringing operational critical IT load to 250 MW (62.5% of the 400 MW campus). This milestone adds approximately $85M to $100M per year in high-margin recurring base rent to Q4 FY26 base rent ($44.1M), directly validating management execution against sector-wide construction delays. At a 12.77% WACC, our updated 5-year DCF yields a probability-weighted fair value of $24.09 (Bear $2.78 at 25%, Base $21.32 at 55%, Bull $58.32 at 20%). Note: valuation lenses disagree by 110% (DCF $24.09 vs Comps $50.59 midpoint); comps are distorted by ramp-stage peer multiples and given low weight. With the stock surging +10.5% today into the $28.00 to $29.00 range, APLD trades at a ~16-20% premium to fair value. Recommendation: MAINTAIN (Core holding: 32 shares, 2.64% target weight). Do not chase the news pop; await Q1 FY27 earnings (Oct 9) for audited recurring cash flow trajectory and financing terms.

aiThesis.rationale: Applied Digital Corporation (APLD) achieved Ready for Service (RFS) for 75 MW at Polaris Forge 1 Building 2 Phase 2, expanding live operational capacity to 250 MW (62.5% of the 400 MW campus). This milestone adds roughly $85M to $100M in annual recurring base rent, significantly accelerating the ramp from Q4 FY26 recurring rent of $44.1M. While CEO Wes Cummins candidly warned on CNBC of sector-wide construction and power interconnect delays across 2026-2027, APLD's successful delivery in Ellendale, ND proves that its modular franchise model is executing. At a 12.77% WACC, our updated 5-year DCF yields a probability-weighted fair value of $24.09 (Bear $2.78 at 25%, Base $21.32 at 55%, Bull $58.32 at 20%). Note on lens divergence: valuation lenses disagree by 110% (DCF $24.09 vs Comps $50.59 midpoint). Comps are based on only two peers (CORZ, IREN) where ramp-stage EV/Sales multiples (29.3x) inflate implied valuations; we rely on DCF. Following today's +10.5% news surge to ~$28.00-$29.00, APLD trades at a ~16-20% premium to fair value. Recommendation: MAINTAIN (Core Holding: 32 shares, 2.64% target weight). We advise against chasing the gap up, as high debt service (~$9B at 6.75-7.0%) and Series G conversion dilution remain active risks. We will reassess following Q1 FY27 earnings on October 9.

name: APLD AI HPC Infrastructure Valuation
rationale: Applied Digital Corporation (APLD) is executing on ~1.41 GW of contracted critical IT load across five campuses, representing ~B in 15-year base lease value (~B with renewals). Polaris Forge 1 (Ellendale, ND) has 175 MW live with anchor tenant CoreWeave; Polaris Forge 2 (Harwood, ND, ~280 MW) is on track for partial operations by year-end 2026. At ~.25, our 5-year DCF yields a fair value of .76 (+26.6% upside at 9.72% WACC). Recent initiations from Wells Fargo ( PT) and Rothschild Redburn ( PT) bracket our valuation. Recommendation: MAINTAIN / ACCUMULATE (Core Holding: 32.0 shares, 2.65% target weight). Accumulate on pullbacks near .50, trim Tier 1 at .76.
